title: Fixed-Height Weyl--Schur Sampling for Free-Tail Canonical Systems
summary: We study the finite sampling map $H \mapsto \bigl(v_{H,Λ}(x_k + iη)\bigr)_{k=1}^M$ for trace-normed canonical systems on $[0,Λ]$ with free tail $H(s)=\frac{1}{2}I$ for $s \ge Λ$, where $v_{H,Λ}$ is the Schur transform of the Weyl coefficient. At the free Hamiltonian $H_0 \equiv \frac{1}{2}I$, we obtain an explicit first-order expansion with quadratic remainder; the linearization is a weighted Fourier--Laplace transform.
